# Marlbridge

> Marlbridge helps learners build the knowledge, confidence and skills they need to succeed in school, examinations, higher education and beyond.

## Boards

- [AQA](https://marlbridge.com/boards/aqa/): 25 subject and qualification combinations across 3 qualifications.
- [Cambridge](https://marlbridge.com/boards/cambridge/): 54 subject and qualification combinations across 3 qualifications.
- [International Baccalaureate](https://marlbridge.com/boards/ib/): 21 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [OCR](https://marlbridge.com/boards/ocr/): 12 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [OxfordAQA](https://marlbridge.com/boards/oxfordaqa/): 30 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.
- [Pearson Edexcel](https://marlbridge.com/boards/edexcel/): 18 subject and qualification combinations across 2 qualifications.

## Qualifications

- [A Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/a-level/): 59 subject and board combinations across 5 boards.
- [AS Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/as-level/): 1 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [GCSE](https://marlbridge.com/levels/gcse/): 17 subject and board combinations across 2 boards.
- [IB Diploma Programme](https://marlbridge.com/levels/ib-dp/): 16 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [IB Middle Years Programme](https://marlbridge.com/levels/ib-myp/): 5 subject and board combinations across 1 board.
- [IGCSE](https://marlbridge.com/levels/igcse/): 45 subject and board combinations across 3 boards.
- [O Level](https://marlbridge.com/levels/o-level/): 17 subject and board combinations across 1 board.

## Subjects

- [Accounting](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/accounting/): Accounting at O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Biology](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/biology/): Biology at IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Business](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/business/): Business at O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Chemistry](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/chemistry/): Chemistry at IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Commerce](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/commerce/): Commerce at IGCSE and O Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Computer Science](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/computer-science/): Computer Science at IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Economics](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/economics/): Economics at O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [English Literature](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/english-literature/): English Literature at IGCSE, GCSE and A Level, across Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel, AQA and OxfordAQA.
- [English](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/english/): English Language at IGCSE, O Level, GCSE and A Level, across Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel, AQA and OxfordAQA.
- [Environmental Management](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/environmental-management/): Environmental Management at IGCSE and O Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Environmental Systems and Societies](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/environmental-systems-and-societies/): IB DP Environmental Systems and Societies (ESS), an interdisciplinary sciences / individuals-and-societies course.
- [Geography](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/geography/): Geography at IGCSE, O Level and A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Global Perspectives](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/global-perspectives/): Global Perspectives at IGCSE and A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Global Politics](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/global-politics/): IB DP Global Politics, exploring power, sovereignty and contemporary political issues.
- [ICT](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/ict/): ICT at IGCSE · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Islamiyat](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/islamiyat/): Islamiyat at IGCSE and O Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Language A: Language and Literature](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/language-a-language-and-literature/): IB DP Language A: Language and Literature, with study material organised by course component.
- [Language A: Literature](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/language-a-literature/): IB DP Language A: Literature, with study material organised by course component.
- [Language B](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/language-b/): IB DP Language B, a language acquisition course for students with prior experience of the target language.
- [Languages](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/languages/): An index of language subjects, each confirmed individually on its own page.
- [Law](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/law/): Law at A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/mathematics-analysis-and-approaches/): IB DP Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches, emphasising rigorous mathematical argument and abstract problem solving.
- [Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/mathematics-applications-and-interpretation/): IB DP Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation, emphasising technology-driven, real-world mathematical modelling.
- [Mathematics](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/mathematics/): Mathematics at IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Design (MYP)](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/myp-design/): IB MYP Design, applying the design cycle to solve practical, real-world problems.
- [Individuals and Societies (MYP)](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/myp-individuals-and-societies/): IB MYP Individuals and Societies, covering history, geography, economics and related humanities disciplines.
- [Language Acquisition (MYP)](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/myp-language-acquisition/): IB MYP Language Acquisition, developing additional-language proficiency and intercultural understanding.
- [Sciences (MYP)](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/myp-sciences/): IB MYP Sciences, an integrated science course exploring inquiry, investigation and real-world application.
- [Pakistan Studies](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/): Pakistan Studies at IGCSE and O Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Physics](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/physics/): Physics at IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Psychology](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/psychology/): Psychology at GCSE · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Sociology](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/sociology/): Sociology at GCSE · IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Statistics](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/statistics/): Statistics at IGCSE and O Level, with study material organised by topic.
- [Urdu Language](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/urdu-language/): Urdu Language at IGCSE, O Level and A Level, across Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel.
- [World History](https://marlbridge.com/subjects/world-history/): World History at GCSE · IGCSE · O · A Level, with study material organised by topic.
